horror_image_prompts3.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. He sits facing viewer across a worn wooden meeting table in a dim abandoned Japanese village community hall at midnight, dusty dark curtains, aged wood walls and old fluorescent fixture. He is completely still, politely waiting, eerie normal social situation, NOT jumping at camera. White fitted T-shirt with natural muscle shape and cloth folds, NO nipple bumps or point highlights or local chest dots. Mask remains properly worn. Exact reference identity, no redesign, no sheet layout or text. Realistic cinematic rendering, muted green/amber shadows, no other people, no extra faces, no captions.
